correctness.rationale: For C_r from 1->101,0->000, m=3^r, and V_r=C_r0^m, the cutwise shortest proper border equals 2m at cuts 0,m, equals 1 at zero-padding or equal-neighbor cuts, and otherwise equals 2*3^{v3(i)}. The structural recurrence C_{r+1}=C_r0^mC_r, palindrome and no-adjacent-ones properties, plus the 0101/1010 block pattern at nontrivial triadic transitions show a 2*3^j border that is itself unbordered (0^{3^j}C_j or reverse), proving minimality; counting transitions establishes multiplicities 2^{r-j}. Longer factors of C_{r+1} have border length length-2m from the 2m periodicity. Independent naive conjugate-prefix/suffix checks for r=0..4 confirm exact spectrum and boundary r=0; source checker.py independently covers r up to 6. Finite cases merely corroborate the unbounded block argument.
